---
name: Missing data
about: Layoff numbers or pricing for an entry marked "No outcome reported"
title: "Data: "
labels: missing-data
---

**Entry**
Splice, Alight Motion, Issuu, MileIQ and Eventbrite currently have no outcome reporting.

**The figure**
Headcount cut, percentage, or a before-and-after price with the customer named.

**Source**
A link. Reddit and forum posts are fine as evidence that users reacted, but not as the
sole source for a number.
